voice.name: Open Sector - Borg Drone
voice.note: Shares the Borg Drone voice (voices/borgdrone.json): no new custom voice. Quiet, mostly whispered delivery for the cloaked sniper.
voice.description: A thin, flat, hollow chorus of many young androgynous voices speaking the same words in perfect unison, like a single drone of an alien cyborg hive: lighter and younger than a commander, emotionless and obedient, airy and slightly metallic with a faint electronic buzz and a hollow tube-like resonance, quick clipped machine cadence, no personality of its own.

fire.prompt: Sci-fi bone spine sniper shot: one very sharp loud supersonic crack like a sniper rifle, with a thin hissing whip of a bone needle streaking away fast, no gunpowder echo, close, outdoors battlefield, no music, no voice

cloak.prompt: Faint sci-fi cloaking device engaging: a soft airy shimmering whoosh bending down in pitch, a thin glassy warble fading into silence, subtle and quiet, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Quick light running footsteps of a slender cyborg on gravel, eight fast clearly audible footfalls with crunching grit and small soft metal clicks, steady rhythm spread evenly over two seconds, close, no music, no voice
